note: Road-marking iso ground tiles. COMPOSED from isoground/asphalt.png (128x81) by painting worn white/yellow road paint (~70% opacity) onto the diamond TOP face only (apex (64,0), left (0,32), right (127,32), bottom (64,64)); the extruded asphalt side walls below y=32 are left untouched. Markings are built in ground coords (u,v) in [0,1]^2 and projected with pixel=(64+64u-64v, 32u+32v), so every stripe/arrow/triangle LIES FLAT on the iso plane (follows the 2:1 diamond slope, never vertical). Same diamond format/metrics as env/isoground. Orientation convention: _a = road runs along the apex->right axis (travel = +u), _b = road runs along the apex->left axis (travel = +v); the two are mirror orientations of the same marking. Crosswalk/stop bars run ACROSS the road; arrows point ALONG the road; give-way uses shark-teeth + dashed yield line.
